stories.title: Houthi rebels strike two airports in southern Saudi Arabia
stories.summary: Attacks damaged airports in Jazan and Najran as Saudi-backed Yemeni forces push a counteroffensive to retake the Red Sea coast. The escalation threatens the Bab al-Mandeb shipping route and regional oil flows.

stories.title: Yemeni forces say they have 'secured' the Bab al-Mandab Strait
stories.summary: Saudi-backed government forces say they retook the Red Sea coast around Bab al-Mandab, including the port city of Mokha, in a major offensive against the Houthis. Control of the strait matters for global shipping and energy routes.

stories.title: Ukraine hits Moscow with one of its largest drone attacks in two years
stories.summary: Roughly 650 drones were launched overnight at Moscow and the surrounding region, killing one man and wounding several, Russian officials said. Moscow said most were downed; the strike signals continued deep-strike pressure as winter approaches.

stories.title: Hundreds of police guard India's capital ahead of voter-roll protest
stories.summary: Security forces barricaded the Election Commission office in New Delhi before an opposition march demanding the election chief resign over a contested revision of voter lists. The dispute has raised concerns about the commission's neutrality.

stories.title: AI agents help surface two room-temperature magnetic semiconductor candidates
stories.summary: Researchers report that Opus 5.5 agents identified two candidate room-temperature magnetic semiconductors, a class of material long sought for low-power spintronic computing. If confirmed, the find points to AI-assisted materials discovery moving from screening to new candidates.

stories.title: Reflection unveils Beam, a 501B-parameter open-weight model
stories.summary: Reflection introduced Beam, a sparse mixture-of-experts model with 501B total and 23B active parameters aimed at coding and agentic work, trained with more than 100 million RL rollouts on 10.5K Nvidia GB300 GPUs. Weights and a technical report are promised later this month.

stories.title: OpenAI rolls out textGrain watermarking for AI-generated text
stories.summary: OpenAI is adding an invisible watermark, textGrain, to eligible ChatGPT and Codex output inside the EU to comply with the bloc's AI Act, with API customers worldwide able to opt in. OpenAI says detection remains early-stage and is limiting the rollout for feedback.

stories.title: Browns notes: pass rush production, trade chatter and a possible key injury
stories.summary: Cleveland's daily roundup covers the team's sack production, continuing trade speculation and an injury to monitor ahead of Week 6. The Browns are trying to protect their spot atop the AFC North.

stories.title: Analyst floats three trades to set the Browns up for a deep playoff run
stories.summary: A Cleveland-focused breakdown argues the Browns should deal from their crowded roster before the November deadline to add help for a playoff push. It frames the moves as upgrades rather than a rebuild.

stories.title: Browns insider shuts down Shedeur Sanders trade talk
stories.summary: A team-connected reporter pushed back on growing speculation that Cleveland could move quarterback Shedeur Sanders before the Nov. 10 deadline. The debate centers on whether the Browns keep four quarterbacks on the roster.

stories.title: Kickoff time set for Ohio State's game at Indiana
stories.summary: The Big Ten announced the start time for the Buckeyes' Oct. 17 road trip to Indiana, a matchup of top-10 teams. Ohio State returns home to face Maryland on Saturday first.

stories.title: Column: Jeremiah Smith should feast on Maryland's pass defense
stories.summary: A Columbus Dispatch columnist argues the homecoming matchup is a prime chance for Jeremiah Smith to pad his Heisman case, noting Maryland ranks near the bottom nationally in defensive passing efficiency. Smith has posted back-to-back 200-yard receiving games.

stories.title: Ohio State lines up another big defensive line recruiting weekend
stories.summary: The Buckeyes will host 2028 five-star defensive linemen for the Maryland homecoming game as they try to protect the nation's top early 2028 class. Both visitors rank among the highest-rated defensive line prospects in the cycle.

stories.title: Ryan Day says Texas collapse was a wake-up call for a rebuilt roster
stories.summary: Day said the Week 2 fourth-quarter loss at Texas forced roughly 60 new players to absorb the 'you're not allowed to lose here' standard at Ohio State. He credited that reset for the road win at Iowa and said the focus is now on avoiding complacency against Maryland.

stories.title: Report: 2030 engine rules to pair twin turbos with a smaller hybrid
stories.summary: A report outlines the expected 2030 Formula 1 power unit regulations, built around twin-turbo V8s with a reduced hybrid element. The rules will shape which manufacturers commit to the next engine cycle.

stories.title: Mekies admits Red Bull's first engine win was a surprise
stories.summary: Red Bull team boss Laurent Mekies said the squad's maiden victory with its own Ford-badged power unit, at the Bahrain GP in Malaysia, came sooner than expected. Max Verstappen's win was the first for Red Bull Ford Powertrains.

stories.title: Honda confirms Watanabe exit and new HRC boss from January
stories.summary: Honda will install a new head of its racing division from January as Koji Watanabe departs. The change lands as Honda prepares to supply engines under F1's next regulations.

stories.title: Alonso reportedly set for a Dakar return with Aston Martin
stories.summary: Reports link Fernando Alonso to another Dakar Rally appearance backed by Aston Martin. The two-time F1 champion has continued cross-discipline racing while his F1 future beyond 2026 remains undecided.

stories.title: Escape from Tarkov's biggest PvE update arrives with Prestige
stories.summary: Patch 1.2.0.0 adds the long-awaited PvE Prestige system, an EXFIL Brothers referral program with in-game rewards, reworked AI PMC behaviour and loot changes. PvE players can also now buy rubles with real money, a PvP-excluded feature.

stories.title: Battlestate begins installing Tarkov patch 1.2.0.0, servers offline
stories.summary: Battlestate Games started deploying update 1.2.0.0 at 07:04 UTC, warning installation will take five to seven hours and that the game will be unavailable. The patch notes detail the PvE prestige reset requirements and EXFIL Brothers rewards.

stories.title: Polygon: Tarkov's new update reworks bots and finally adds PvE prestige
stories.summary: Coverage of patch 1.2.0.0 highlights the overhaul of AI-controlled PMC behaviour alongside six PvE prestige levels, the biggest shift yet for players who avoid PvP. It also notes changes to how players level up and loot is distributed.

stories.title: Early voting opens in Ohio ahead of the Nov. 3 election
stories.summary: In-person early voting began Tuesday in Ohio, where voters will decide the Gahanna charter amendments (Issues 18-27), school levies and other Franklin County ballot questions. Early voting runs through the day before the Nov. 3 general election.

stories.title: How much daylight Columbus will lose in October
stories.summary: Columbus is on track to shed a significant amount of evening daylight this month as sunset moves earlier each week. The shift matters for commuters, school schedules and after-work activities across central Ohio.

stories.title: Ohio blogger faces trial over obscene Shrek image sent to a state senator
stories.summary: Columbus political blogger D.J. Byrnes is set to stand trial Oct. 8 on a misdemeanor telecommunications harassment charge for sending an obscene Shrek image to a state senator. He has pleaded not guilty in one of Ohio's more unusual criminal cases.

stories.title: About a dozen new Ohio laws take effect Tuesday
stories.summary: New state laws taking effect Oct. 6 require drivers to give basic identifying information at traffic stops and add new mandates for schools, among other measures. The changes affect drivers, students and local agencies across central Ohio.
